Then she goes to torpor:
Pulled Fangs [Jyhad, V:TES, SW, CE]
Cardtype: Combat

Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this minion
inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing vampire. Not
usable by a dying ally or a vampire going into torpor.
Put this card on the opposing vampire, and this minion inflicts 1
point of damage. The victim cannot hunt until this card is removed.
Any vampire(s) may burn this card with two +1 stealth actions. If the
victim must hunt and cannot, he or she goes into torpor. A vampire can
have only 1 Pulled Fangs.

> [...] If the victim must hunt and cannot, he or she goes into torpor. [...]

Correct.

> > And what about an empty ravnos when week of Nightmare is in play ?

If the vampire must hunt, he or she goes to torpor.
Empty vampires must hunt.

Having an alternate hunt option doesn't change that.

> I have more questions of Kyoko.
>
> Can she hunt more than once in a turn?

No.

> If she can, will she always steal a blood from another vampire?

Moot.
